name: Gayle Benson

views.text: Some decisions an owner has to make herself, even when her general manager sees it differently.
Firing the general manager who brought this city a title would be ridiculous.
The right head coach is the one who fits this organization and this city.
The Saints belong in New Orleans, now and after me.
A slow start under a new coach deserves time.
This team is part of the community's recovery after every storm.

signatures: speaks of the team as part of the city
defends longtime executives against fan criticism

motivation.want: to keep the Saints winning and rooted in New Orleans for generations
motivation.fear: fans turning on the organization she has kept loyal

voice: Gracious, faith-tinged and community-minded, firm when defending her people. Short statements that center the city and the fans.

evidence.summary: Benson fired Dennis Allen after a 2-7 start, saying it was a decision she felt the team needed to make; reports said GM Mickey Loomis was against it.
New Orleans hired Eagles OC Kellen Moore after a search led by Loomis, whom Benson kept.
Benson donated $1 million to Hurricane Ida relief in the Gulf Coast.
